item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Zelenskyy offers pause in airstrikes during US envoys’ Moscow trip
item.description: U.S. envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner arrived in Moscow as Russia and Ukraine intensified drone and missile attacks amid stalled peace efforts.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Former Pasco corporal faces numerous charges including unlawful sexual activity with a minor
item.description: Sheriff Chris Nocco said a deputy has been fired and arrested. Former Corporal Donald Valverde faces charges of lewd and lascivious molestation and unlawful sexual activity with a minor.

item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Pasco deputies investigating death after man found dead in Spring Hill: PSO
item.description: Pasco Sheriff's Office (PSO) deputies are conducting a death investigation after an adult man was found dead in the Spring Hill area, according to a social media post.
